veranderings.blok: Die dier kry dit deur te eet
veranderings.rede: A comma closing the embedded relative clause stops 'geëet word self' being read as one unit and makes the long sentence easier for a Grade 4 reader.

veranderings.voor: wys na watter kant die energie beweeg
veranderings.na: wys watter kant toe die energie beweeg
veranderings.rede: 'watter kant toe' is the natural Afrikaans direction phrase and matches the lesson's own 'een kant toe' in the next block.
